conference: Annual Meeting of the Chemical Society of Japan (CSJ) - 106th Spring Annual Meeting
method: Searched in Japanese (rung 2 reword, local term 講演件数 = 'number of presentations'): '日本化学会 年会 講演件数 2026'. Opened the CSJ's own news page (not a search snippet) at chemistry.or.jp/news/106-1.html, which states for the 106th Spring Annual Meeting (Mar 17-20, 2026): '計3,604件のアカデミックプログラムが予定されています' (a total of 3,604 academic-programme items are planned), covering 受賞講演 (award lectures), 若手特別講演 (young-researcher special lectures), 口頭A/B講演 (oral A/B) and ポスター発表 (posters); and '6,000名を超える参加者' (over 6,000 participants). Tried pub.confit.atlas.jp/ja/event/csj106th for a category breakdown to strip out the (likely small) award/special-lecture count, but it 403'd (no further search spent on it, since the total clears the bar by >2x margin regardless). Confidence marked 'dated' because the source page is a pre-event announcement ('are planned'), not a post-meeting actual tally -- I did not find a post-event confirmed count within budget.

conference: Pittcon (Conference on Analytical Chemistry and Applied Spectroscopy) 2026
method: Rung 1 search 'Pittcon 2026 number of technical program abstracts submitted' found only a call-for-abstracts page and the Agenda-of-Sessions PDF (no stated total). Downloaded that PDF (pittcon.org/2026/Pittcon-2026-Agenda-of-Sessions-PDF.pdf, rung 3/4, 0 searches) and grepped session-item IDs with `grep -oE '[A-Z]{1,4}-[0-9]+-[0-9]+' | sed -E 's/^([A-Z]+)-.*/\1/' | sort | uniq -c`: OR (oral)=401, OC (organized/other contributed)=211, SY (invited symposia)=173, AW (awards)=61, WS (workshops)=15. This PDF is oral/symposium/award/workshop only -- it has NO itemized poster list (posters appear only as an unlabelled grid box on a schedule-at-a-glance page, line ~4260 of the extracted text), so 401+211=612 is a floor on contributed orals alone, undercounting the true total because posters (Pittcon's largest single category) are absent from this artefact. Second search 'Pittcon exhibitor prospectus fact sheet attendees technical presentations posters' surfaced pittcon.org/exhibitor/pittcon-demographics/ (404'd when fetched) and pittcon.org/conference/technical-program/ (fetched, no numbers on that page). Fetched the pittcon.org homepage directly (0 extra search) and it states in a stats block: '1,500+ PRESENTATIONS', '40+ SHORT COURSES', '350+ EXHIBITORS', '6,000+ SCIENTISTS' -- this is the Pittcon 2027 promotional homepage, so the figure is a recurring marketing round-number, not a year-specific counted total, and it is a homepage (rule 2/6 caveat: I could not find the same stat on a non-homepage page within the 3-search cap). Excluded AW (award, invited) and SY (invited symposia) from my own PDF count as not contributed; WS (workshops) also excluded as not abstracts. Character HYBRID: exhibition-heavy trade show (6,000+ scientists, 350+ exhibitors) but with a genuine, sizeable contributed oral+poster programme.

1 search ('EuChemS Chemistry Congress 2024 number of abstracts submitted') found no stated total anywhere -- euchems2024.org call-for-abstracts/posters pages, EuChemS magazine highlights, ChemistryViews coverage, RSC/Institute of Chemistry of Ireland listings all describe the congress but state no count. Fetched euchems2024.org/ecc9-programme/ directly (0 search): it confirms a coded session/type system (O = oral communication, FP = flash presentation, P = poster) across 8 themes and up to 14 parallel sessions/day, but the actual session-by-session listing is not static HTML -- curl of the page (saved to /tmp/ecc9.html) shows the whole programme is embedded via `<iframe src="https://virtual.oxfordabstracts.com/#/event/4853/program">`, an Oxford Abstracts SPA (hash-routed, client-side rendered). Probed for a backing REST endpoint (`virtual.oxfordabstracts.com/api/events/4853` -> 'Not Found', 0 search) with no luck -- Oxford Abstracts does not appear to expose an Indico-style JSON export. This is a rung-5 case: the artefact (full O/FP/P-coded session list) exists and is countable, but only behind a JS-rendered SPA that curl/WebFetch cannot render. NEXT ACTION: open https://virtual.oxfordabstracts.com/#/event/4853/program in a real browser (Playwright/Chrome), enumerate sessions across all 8 themes and both oral/poster tracks, and count O + FP + P items (excluding any plenary/keynote track if one is separately labelled). No language other than English applicable -- EuChemS/Ireland is anglophone.

conference: JSAC Annual Meeting (日本分析化学会年会, Japan Society for Analytical Chemistry)
method: Searched in Japanese (rung 1/2): '日本分析化学会 年会 発表件数 参加者数' and '日本分析化学会 第73年会 名古屋工業大学 講演 件' -- no page states a total for the current (73rd/74th) meeting; conference.jsac.jp/73nenkai/ (fetched directly, 0 search) gives only dates/deadlines. Third search '日本分析化学会 事業報告 年会 講演件数 PDF' surfaced conference.jsac.jp/wp-content/uploads/topics/nenkai68-houkoku.pdf, a 'ぶんせき' magazine post-meeting report for the 68th annual meeting (Chiba University, Sept 11-13; dated to 2019 by its own mention of Typhoon Faxai/台風15号 hitting Chiba that week). Downloaded and pdftotext -layout'd it (0 search). It states explicit totals in running text (not just the by-category table 1, which has misaligned columns after extraction and was not hand-summed to avoid a bad count): '一般口頭講演（263件）' (263 general oral), poster section states '若手ポスター発表211件' (211 young-researcher posters), '一般ポスター発表105件' (105 general posters), 'テクノレビューポスター発表2件' (2 vendor techno-review posters). Sum of contributed items = 263+211+105+2 = 581. Explicitly excluded as non-contributed: 7 special/industry symposia (invited speakers, itemized by name), award lectures, the Asian MS invited-lecture session (4 items), and 18 '研究懇談会' organizer-arranged talks (not open-call). Attendance: '有料参加者は1,119名' (1,119 paying participants). Tried to find a more recent report by pattern-guessing nenkai69/70/71/72/73-houkoku.pdf (0 search, all 404) -- the report-PDF series appears to have stopped or moved after the 68th. Confit pages for the 73rd/74th meetings (pub.confit.atlas.jp/ja/event/jsac74nenkai/...) 403/202 both WebFetch and a spoofed-UA curl (Cloudflare-style JS challenge), so a current-year count needs rung 5 (browser). All 3 searches used; recording the dated 2019 figure as the best available rather than leaving the row UNKNOWN, per rung 7 (prior-year figure, marked DATED). NEXT ACTION if pursued further: open pub.confit.atlas.jp/ja/event/jsac74nenkai/... in a real browser to get a current count.

1 search ('AIChE Annual Meeting 2025 number of technical papers presentations submitted') found no stated total, but surfaced proceedings.aiche.org and aiche.confex.com. proceedings.aiche.org/conferences/aiche-annual-meeting/2025/proceeding 403'd on both WebFetch and a spoofed-UA curl (Cloudflare-gated, not usable). Fell back to the Confex backing API (0 further search, per the method's documented AcademyHealth/Confex pattern): `aiche.confex.com/aiche/2025/meetingapi.cgi/Program` returned HTTP 200 with a JSON array of 43 top-level programme codes (divisions, forums, topical conferences, poster sessions, plus admin/social entries), each with a `ChildList_Paper` array of paper references. Summed `len(ChildList_Paper)` across all 43 codes = 7,159. Spot-checked one Paper object per suspicious-looking code (`meetingapi.cgi/Paper/<id>`) to confirm scope: papers under '2025_t7 Regenerative Engineering Society' (co-located topical group), '2025_ascprogram Annual Student Conference' and '2025_t1 Meet the Candidates Poster Sessions' all carry `MeetingTitle: '2025 AIChE Annual Meeting'` and a live (non-withdrawn) `Withdrawn: ''` field, and the aiche.org press-preview PDF confirms 'Meet the Candidates' is a recruiter/poster event at the Annual Meeting itself, not a separate conference -- so all 43 codes are genuinely part of one meeting and none were excluded as duplicates. Codes with 0 papers (Co-Located Events header, Community Meetings & Events, University Receptions, 2025 Annual Meeting Events -- all social/admin) contribute nothing and needed no exclusion. Did NOT exclude the 4 papers under 'Sponsored Technology Workshops' (vendor-sponsored, arguably not open-call) -- negligible at 4/7,159. Did not attempt a full withdrawn-paper audit (would need ~7,000 individual API calls); 3 spot-checked papers were all live, consistent with DAE-SSPS-style overcounting being small relative to a total this large. Second search for attendance ('"AIChE Annual Meeting" 2025 attendees "Boston" registered') and the aiche.org press-preview PDF (fetched, 0 search) both came up empty -- no stated attendee total found, so attendance is left null/UNKNOWN rather than guessed. English-language society, no local-language pass needed.

conference: Gordon Research Conferences (GRC series) - chemistry-relevant subset
method: This row stands for the whole invite-led GRC portfolio, not one meeting, so the question is a chemistry-specific aggregate, which I could not locate. Search 1 ('Gordon Research Conferences chemistry annual number of meetings attendees total') found only individual-meeting attendance figures (e.g. an OSTI DOE final-report PDF for one Inorganic Reaction Mechanisms GRC: 154 participants, poster session 'open to all attendees', no stated poster/abstract count) -- fetched and pdftotext'd that PDF (0 search) and it names no abstract total, only session schedule. Search 2 ('Gordon Research Conferences "each year" total number of scientists attend all conferences') found grc.org/about/, fetched directly (0 search): 'GRC organizes over 395 Gordon Research Conferences (GRCs) and Gordon Research Seminars (GRSs) per year' with 'nearly 40,000 participants' total and 'each conference is limited to 200 attendees' -- but this is ACROSS ALL SCIENTIFIC FIELDS (physics, biology, medicine etc.), not a chemistry-specific figure, and the about page gives no discipline breakdown. Tried grc.org/find-a-grc/?field_1970=Chemistry to get a chemistry-category count (0 search, guessed URL) -- 404'd; GRC's meeting catalog/search is very likely a JS-driven filter (rung 5), not static HTML, so a chemistry-only meeting count needs a browser. Every individual GRC caps at 200 attendees with invited talks plus a poster session open to essentially all attendees -- so per-meeting these fail the bar outright, and the field notes for this census (chemistry_PRE_PILOT.md) already flag this exact row as an unresolved POLICY question ('one row or many?') rather than a pure research gap: even with a chemistry-only meeting count, no plausible single-meeting or additive figure clears 900, and the aggregate 40,000/395-meeting figure is not attributable to chemistry alone. Recording UNKNOWN rather than OUT because I have no positive chemistry-specific evidence either way, per rule 1. NEXT ACTION: (a) rung 5 -- browser-drive grc.org's meeting-finder to enumerate and count Chemistry-tagged GRCs/GRSs for one year, then decide with Rupert whether an aggregate poster count across that subset is the right unit, or (b) treat as a policy decision (one row standing for many small meetings, as the field notes already suggest) rather than a research task.

conference: SPSJ Symposium on Macromolecules (高分子討論会) - 73rd, Niigata University, Sept 25-27 2024
method: 3 Japanese searches ('高分子討論会 発表件数 参加者数'; '"高分子討論会" 講演件数 OR 発表件数 第7'; '高分子討論会 プログラム PDF 講演番号 セッション一覧') found no stated total anywhere -- note search 1's auto-summary conflated this meeting (討論会, held in September) with a DIFFERENT SPSJ event, the 年次大会 (Annual Meeting, held in May, ~3,000 attendees/1,500+ presentations); that figure was NOT used here as it is for the wrong meeting. Search 3 surfaced main.spsj.or.jp/tohron/73tohron/program.html, a static (non-JS) programme index page for the 73rd Touronkai (2024), fetched via curl (0 search) with direct links to full oral and poster PROGRAMME PDFs (oral_ja.pdf, poster_ja.pdf -- distinct from the shorter room-schedule-only PDFs scheduleoral_ja.pdf/scheduleposter_ja.pdf, which were also checked and carry no totals). Downloaded both full PDFs and ran pdftotext in both -layout and -raw modes (0 search each), which agreed exactly. Oral: grep -oE '\b[0-9][A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{2}(IL|AL|ILY)?\b' oral_ja.txt | sort -u -> 882 unique IDs, of which 22 carry the IL suffix (招待講演/特別発表 = invited lecture) and 5 carry AL (受賞講演 = award lecture) -- both excluded per the method's invited-speaker rule, leaving 855 contributed oral papers (IDs run across parallel session rooms A through U, e.g. 1B03...1B12, 2F11...2G08IL, 3T05...3U07 -- contiguous and plausible for a large national meeting). Poster: grep -oE '[0-9]{1,2}P[a-zA-Z][0-9]{3}' poster_ja.txt | sort -u -> 656 unique poster IDs (day-prefix 1/2/3, session-letter a-f, e.g. 1Pa019, 3Pd084), none carrying an IL/AL-style tag, all contributed. Total contributed = 855 oral + 656 poster = 1,511. This clears VERIFIED (>=1,500) by a narrow 11-item margin, so per the spot-check rule for decisive/flip rows I re-ran both extractions in -raw mode as a second independent method and they matched the -layout counts exactly (882/656, zero diff) -- see rule 7. All 3 permitted searches used; no attendance figure was sought given the search cap was exhausted on locating the artefact itself.

conference: CIESC Annual Meeting (中国化工学会年会) - 2023 edition, Guangzhou
method: 3 Chinese searches: (1) '中国化工学会年会 论文 摘要 数量 参会人数' surfaced only the WRONG society's paper-index system (chemsoc.org.cn is 中国化学会/CCS, chemistry, not 中国化工学会/CIESC, chemical engineering -- not used, correctly kept separate from row 10's CCS row). (2) '中国化工学会 年会 论文集 检索系统 site:ciesc.cn' found no CIESC-specific paper retrieval system; fetched ciesc.cn/meetings/ directly (0 search) and it 404'd. (3) '中国化工学会年会 开幕 收到论文 篇 代表 人 出席' found the China Association for Science and Technology's (CAST) own news republication of the 2023 CIESC Annual Meeting (Guangzhou) opening: fetched that exact page (0 search) and it states '学术界、科技界和产业界共3000余位代表参加了会议' (3,000+ delegates from academia, science/tech, and industry attended), and separately that the meeting ran '30-40个专题分论坛' (30-40 thematic sub-forums, per an earlier snippet) with 20+ Chinese Academy of Sciences/Engineering academicians present -- but the page states NO abstract/paper count. All rungs 1-8 exhausted without a countable artefact (no proceedings PDF, no paper-search system, no journal supplement found for this specific national annual meeting) and all 3 searches used, so this goes to rung 9. RATIO JUDGEMENT: CIESC's annual meeting is built on 30-40 parallel thematic sub-forums under one national key-society umbrella (the way AIChE's divisional Annual Meeting is), rather than a single plenary-led congress -- that structure is evidence of a majority-open-call, multi-track programme, but the CAST article's emphasis on academicians and industry leadership (a Chinese national-society flagship event) also suggests a meaningful curated/invited component (keynotes, forum chairs) alongside contributed talks. Judged ratio: 35%, reflecting a hybrid between AIChE-style divisional openness and a more curated flagship-congress format; no counted CIESC or sister-society engineering anchor exists yet in this field to calibrate against (chemistry's counted anchors, e.g. CSJ ~60%, are a different kind of meeting -- pure disciplinary academic society vs. a mixed industry/academy national engineering congress -- so were NOT borrowed across, per the no-shortcuts rule). implied = 3,000 x 0.35 = 1,050 -- ROUNDED, ~1,050 INFERRED FROM ATTENDANCE, NOT COUNTED (rung 9). This already clears the ~900 retention floor directly (no flex test needed). Labelled BORDERLINE per rung-9 rule: an inferred figure can never be VERIFIED.

conference: Mendeleev Conference for Young Scientists (MENDELEEV, St Petersburg) - XIII edition, 2024
method: Searched in Russian (rung 1/2): 'Менделеев конференция молодых ученых Санкт-Петербург тезисы количество участников' -- found only vague attendance ranges (500-700 typical, 1,000+ in 2017) across several university news mirrors (chem.spbu.ru link 404'd; scienceid.net gave only 'более 700 участников' with no presentation count). Second search '"Менделеев" конференция молодых ученых химии "тезисов" количество докладов устных постерных' surfaced a summary claiming 'more than 800 scientific presentations' for Mendeleev 2024, sourced back to spbu.ru/news-events/calendar/mendeleev-2024 -- St Petersburg State University's own official event-calendar page (the conference's host institution, not a snippet). Opened that exact page directly and it states: 'более 1000 химиков из десяти стран' (more than 1,000 chemists from ten countries) and 'более 800 научных докладов' (more than 800 scientific reports), with no oral/poster breakdown given. This is a reported, not counted, figure (rung 8 -- host-institution announcement), so per the method it is NOT ratio-flexed, only tested against the retention floor directly: 'более 800' (800+) is within 100 of the ~900 floor, which the method's own worked example (WOC's reported 800 posters) says passes at the current ~900 bar. Recorded as BORDERLINE rather than OUT. No proceedings/abstract-book PDF or paper-index system was found for this specific conference within the 2 searches used (rung 3/4 artefacts not located) -- a third search was available but not spent, since the SPbU primary-source figure was judged sufficient and decisive at this margin.

conference: 中国化学会学术年会 (CCS National Congress) - 34th edition, Guangzhou, June 15-18 2024
method: First search for this row ('中国化学会第34届学术年会 广州 论文 摘要 数量 参会代表人数') surfaced chemsoc.org.cn's paper-retrieval system (library/papers/, meeting id=296 for the 34th) as a candidate rung-4 artefact, but curl and WebFetch both only returned a client-side JS loading shell ('中国化学会官网 正在加载中') -- the paper list itself is behind JS rendering and would need rung 5 (browser) to enumerate. Instead, the same and a follow-up search ('中国化学会第34届学术年会 交流论文9371篇 圆满闭幕') surfaced a stated breakdown; fetched the actual primary-source announcement directly (not a snippet) at chemsoc.org.cn/a5933.html (title: '中国化学会第34届学术年会落下帷幕'), which states verbatim: '交流论文9371篇' (9,371 papers exchanged/communicated -- headline total including all format types), and the session breakdown '大会特邀报告3个，分会主题报告258个，分会邀请报告1700个、分会口头报告2291个，快闪报告481个，墙报展示3356个' (3 plenary invited reports, 258 divisional thematic reports, 1,700 divisional INVITED reports, 2,291 divisional ORAL reports, 481 flash reports, 3,356 poster/wall displays), and '包括90余位两院院士在内的15000余位化学科技工作者和学生参加会议' (15,000+ chemistry workers/students including 90+ CAS/CAE academicians attended). Per the method's invited-speaker exclusion, EXCLUDED: the 3 plenary invited reports, 258 divisional thematic reports (organizer-invited), and 1,700 divisional invited reports = 1,961 excluded. COUNTED (contributed) = 2,291 oral + 481 flash + 3,356 poster = 6,128. Note: this contributed total plus the excluded 1,961 sums to 8,089, not the headline 9,371 -- the 1,282-item gap is unexplained by the source (possibly proceedings-only papers with no live presentation slot); the headline 9,371 was NOT used as the reported figure specifically because it cannot be cleanly split into contributed vs invited, and the 6,128 session-level breakdown is what the method's invited-exclusion rule can actually be applied to. Two independent numbers from the same official announcement (oral+flash+poster breakdown vs the aggregate headline) both comfortably clear 1,500 regardless of which is used, so the ambiguity does not affect the verdict.

conference: 全国理论与计算化学会议 (National Conference on Theoretical and Computational Chemistry) - 15th edition, Changchun, Aug 6-9 2024
method: Searched in Chinese: '全国理论与计算化学会议 论文 摘要 数量 参会人数' -- found the host institution's (Jilin University) own news report on the 15th edition (2024, Changchun) at news.jlu.edu.cn/info/1021/58525.htm; fetched it directly with curl (WebFetch failed with a parse error) and grepped the decoded HTML for 论文/报告/墙报/参会 context. The article states: '12个精彩的大会报告' (12 plenary/keynote reports -- invited, excluded), and for the 5 thematic sub-sessions plus 2 youth forums, '作了293个邀请和口头报告，并展示交流了340份墙报' (293 INVITED-AND-ORAL reports combined -- the source does not separate the invited/contributed split within this figure -- plus 340 poster boards exchanged/displayed). No total attendance/participant headcount is stated anywhere in the article (checked for 人参加/人参会/余人/代表/规模/注册, none give a headcount). Because the 293 figure conflates invited and contributed oral reports without a stated split, I could not isolate a precise contributed-oral count; instead I used the UPPER BOUND (treating all 293 as if contributed, which cannot be exceeded) plus the unambiguous 340 posters: 293+340 = 633. Even this most generous upper-bound total falls well short of the ~900 retention floor, so the true (invited-excluded) contributed count is <=633 and the OUT verdict is robust to the ambiguity in the oral/invited split. Only 1 of 3 permitted searches used since the host-institution report already gave a decisive (upper-bound) figure well below the floor; no second/third search was needed to refine it further, per rule 1 (don't spend budget confirming a small society is small once evidence already clears the question).

conference: Менделеевский съезд по общей и прикладной химии (Mendeleev Congress on General and Applied Chemistry) - XXI edition, St Petersburg, Sept 9-13 2019
method: Search 1 ('Менделеевский съезд по общей и прикладной химии число докладов участников') found a TASS article headline claiming 5,366 reports for the XXI Congress (St Petersburg, 2019), but the live nauka.tass.ru/tass.ru URL is a JS-rendered SPA (confirmed via curl with a spoofed UA: page body is just a spinner shell) -- both WebFetch and curl 403/blank on the live page, so rung 5 territory for the live site. Recovered the actual article text via the Wayback Machine (web.archive.org/web/20201026105536/https://nauka.tass.ru/nauka/6885217, 0 search) instead, which IS static and gives the full article verbatim: 'На XXI съезд зарегистрировались почти 4 тыс. участников из 60 стран мира' (nearly 4,000 registered participants from 60 countries) and '...они сделали 5366 докладов, что стало еще одним рекордом' (they gave 5,366 reports/talks, another record), attributed on-record to the Organizing Committee's scientific secretary. This includes some plenary/invited talks from Nobel laureates and IUPAC/society presidents (an unstated small number), but even a generous exclusion of dozens of plenary speakers leaves several thousand contributed reports, so the VERIFIED threshold is not sensitive to that ambiguity. Search 2 ('"5366" докладов Менделеевский съезд') was used to corroborate and also surfaced a NEWER edition: the XXII Congress (Sirius, Oct 7-12 2024) has its own 7-volume printed abstract collection (publications.hse.ru/books/974511507, 'Сборник тезисов докладов в 7 томах') -- fetched that page (0 search) and it gives only Vol.3's page count (356pp, no per-item count) and no aggregate total; also fetched permsc.ru's XXII Congress press item (0 search), which confirms comparable scale for the newer edition -- 'более 4000 участников... из 39 стран' (4,000+ participants, 39 countries), 9 plenary sessions (18 invited plenary lecturers), 75 section meetings across 9 sections, 12 symposia, 2 round tables, 3 poster sessions -- but states NO report/abstract count. Recording the 2019 figure as DATED rather than leaving the row UNKNOWN, since the 2024 edition's near-identical attendance (4,000+ vs ~4,000) is positive evidence the scale has not shrunk. All 3 permitted searches were not needed; 2 used.

conference: РОСКАТАЛИЗ — Российский конгресс по катализу (Russian Congress on Catalysis) - V edition, St Petersburg, April 21-26 2025
method: Search 1 ('РОСКАТАЛИЗ Российский конгресс по катализу количество докладов участников тезисов') found only abstract-collection catalogue records (istina.msu.ru) for the III/IV editions with no counts, and the V edition's own event site (ruscat-5.tilda.ws / zioc.ru), fetched directly (0 search) -- zioc.ru gave only the abstract-submission deadline, no figures. Search 2 ('"РОСКАТАЛИЗ" 2025 Санкт-Петербург конгресс итоги участников тезисов докладов число') found the Boreskov Institute of Catalysis SB RAS's own post-event report, 'Роскатализ-2025: любое окончание — новое начало' (snm.catalysis.ru), which I fetched directly and it states: 'В нем очно приняли участие более 500 человек' (more than 500 people attended in person) and the scientific programme included 5 plenary lectures, 9 keynote lectures, 3 round tables, '190 устных' (190 oral reports) and '128 стендовых докладов' (128 poster reports). conference: Reunión del Grupo Especializado de Ciencia y Tecnologías (Bio)analíticas (GCTbA) - RSEQ - III edition, Bilbao, July 4 2025
method: 1 search ('Grupo Especializado Ciencias Tecnologías Bioanalíticas RSEQ reunión número de comunicaciones participantes') confirmed this placeholder resolves to a real, existing meeting: the III Reunión Científica del Grupo Especializado en Ciencia y Tecnologías (Bio)Analíticas (GCTbA) of the RSEQ, held as a one-day meeting July 4 2025 in Bilbao (a specialized-group meeting held alongside the RSEQ's XL Biennial Meeting, per gctba.rseq.org), and directly surfaced its own 'Libro de Resúmenes' (book of abstracts) PDF. Downloaded and pdftotext -layout'd that PDF (0 search): it states in running text 'Las 5 presentaciones... [Comunicaciones Invitadas-Premios]... A estas se suman 27 presentaciones orales y 59 comunicaciones tipo póster' (27 oral presentations plus 59 poster communications, in addition to the invited award-lecture talks, which are excluded per the method). Cross-checked the 59-poster figure independently by grepping unique poster IDs (grep -oE '\bP[0-9]{1,3}\.' | sort -u -> P1 through P59, exactly 59 unique IDs, confirming the stated text). COUNTED (contributed) = 27 oral + 59 poster = 86. This is consistent with the field notes' expectation that RSEQ's 30 specialized-group reuniones are individually small (this group has ~290 total members; a prior article -- gctba.rseq.org's 'MemoriaGCTbA' one-year retrospective, fetched for context -- states the II edition (2023) had 237 attendees). Positive evidence the meeting is far below the retention floor; the placeholder is now resolved to a real, named, dated meeting rather than left as an unconfirmed federation-implied entry.
